notes.title: Killon Update Released
notes.content:
The new update will include:

- Single button for shooting to simplify controls
- Normal mode completely rebalanced and adjusted
- Previous Normal mode will now become the Hard Mode with some minor adjustments
- More lives in the Practice sessions
- Collecting the [F] [I] [R] [E] letters gives you an extra life in Normal mode
- Minor tweaks and fixes

Thanks

notes.title: Killon updated
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]New changes to the respawn invincibility and timing in Normal mode.
[*]Added respawn invincibility jet color and flames.
[*]Hard mode respawn reworked.
[*]Improved respawn enemy destruction and timing.
[*]Wide-shot Cannon weapon power increased.
[*]Rebalanced some enemy attack patterns.
[*]Weapon SFX amplified.
[*]Demo build prepared based off this build.
[/list]
Thanks again for all of the great feedback.

Enjoy
